title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in wpLingua…
description: A stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the wpLingua Translation Service plugin for WordPress, affecting versions up to 3.1.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of users' browsers.
